# TODO: Vision (Sim + Real) Architecture — CTRE Phoenix Swerve + PhotonVision + Turret (C++)

## 1) Core data types (shared by sim + real)
- [ ] Define `struct VisionMeasurement`
  - [ ] `frc::Pose2d pose`
  - [ ] `units::second_t timestamp`
  - [ ] `wpi::array<double, 3> stdDevs` (x, y, theta)
  - [ ] `std::string source` (camera name: `FL/FR/BL/BR`)
- [ ] Define a small interface: `class VisionIO`
  - [ ] `virtual std::vector<VisionMeasurement> GetMeasurements() = 0;`
  - [ ] optional debug: `GetStatus()` / `GetLastTargets()` / `GetRejectedCounts()`

---

## 2) Constants (one source of truth for both sim + real)
- [ ] Camera names: `FL`, `FR`, `BL`, `BR`
- [ ] `frc::Transform3d robotToCamera[4]` (measured, meters/degrees)
- [ ] Turret pivot location in robot frame: `frc::Translation2d turretPivotInRobot`
- [ ] AprilTag field layout (current season)
- [ ] “Goal” tag IDs we are allowed to aim at (whitelist)

---

## 3) VisionIOReal (PhotonVision on 2× Pi 4, 4× ThriftyCam)
- [ ] Read PV outputs from NetworkTables for each camera name
  - [ ] Get latest pipeline result + timestamp
  - [ ] Build pose estimate (from PV pose output, or from PhotonPoseEstimator running on rio if that’s the chosen model)
- [ ] Apply measurement gating (per camera)
  - [ ] Reject: no targets / stale timestamp
  - [ ] Reject: high ambiguity / bad solve
  - [ ] Reject: unrealistic jump vs current estimate (optional)
- [ ] Compute/assign `stdDevs` (distance-based scaling)
- [ ] Return `std::vector<VisionMeasurement>` each loop

Notes:
- [ ] Keep camera naming consistent with PhotonVision UI (`FL/FR/BL/BR`)
- [ ] Real cameras live on 2 Pi 4s (2 cams each); robot code shouldn’t care which Pi

---

## 4) VisionIOSim (desktop sim)
- [ ] Build PhotonLib sim rig
  - [ ] `photon::VisionSystemSim` with AprilTag layout
  - [ ] 4× `photon::PhotonCamera` + `photon::PhotonCameraSim`
  - [ ] Attach each sim camera with the same `robotToCamera` transform
- [ ] Each sim tick:
  - [ ] Update vision sim with **ground-truth** pose (`simTruePose`)
  - [ ] For each camera, read simulated results and produce `VisionMeasurement`
- [ ] Use the same gating + stdDev logic as real (or as close as possible)

Critical rule:
- [ ] Vision sim must use **simTruePose**, not the drivetrain’s estimated pose

---

## 5) Drivetrain fusion (CTRE Phoenix swerve generated by Tuner X)
- [ ] In drivetrain `Periodic()`:
  - [ ] Update odometry / internal pose estimate
  - [ ] Pull measurements from `VisionIO->GetMeasurements()`
  - [ ] For each accepted measurement: call CTRE `AddVisionMeasurement(pose, timestamp, stdDevs)`
- [ ] Provide `GetEstimatedPose()` for turret + dashboards

  - [ ] Select goal tag pose from layout using whitelist/strategy
